The AI Assistant is activated. It answers questions about BabaCAD Robotics Web and writes tasks for the robot as plugin code.

We recommend starting with the /demo prompt: type /demo in the assistant and send it. It asks for a line move to a pose and a turn of the first joint, so you can see how a task is answered, saved and run with the Play button.

Each question sends part of the BRW documentation to the model, so the first answer can take a while.

To improve the AI Assistant's answers we would like to collect the questions you ask it and your ratings of its answers. Please confirm or reject this below; you can change it any time by clicking "Activate..." again. Without your consent nothing is collected.

You are about to download the demo projects as one zip file. Unzip it; each project is a folder.

To load a project, open the menu swap_vert and click upload_2 Import Workspace , then choose the project's folder.

Then just click Play to run the project, or a User Command button when the project contains only plugin code (like the singularity demo).

The demo projects:

- Cell demo: run User Commands 1 to 3.

- Mill / Sculpt demo: open the menu Tools & Objects â Mill / Sculpt, click "Generate milling program", then "Start simulation".

- Singularity demo: run the simulation first, then User Commands 1 to 3.

- Collision Avoidance demo: start the simulation (>>) to see the robot collide with the yellow box; then open Tools & Objects â Collision Avoidance, set Precision to 0, click "Recalculate trajectory" and play the simulation again.
